issuer: the Iowa Department of Transportation, Motor Vehicle Division
note: Iowa DOT's fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives the Class C operator's licence at $4 a year of its term, and an ID card at $8 for 8 years; its renewal page's expiration table gives eight years from 17 years and 11 months through 72, so the licence was kept as 8 years at $32 ($4 times 8, a product of the page's figures). The full licence page says a full licence, the third step of the graduated licence, is available at 17 (marked "under eighteen" until 18), so it is kept from 17. No youngest age for the card was read. On 2026-10-30 the licence was rewritten with the terms set by the holder's age, from the renewal page's expiration table, each at $4 a year of its term (the products of the pages' figures, as the 8-year $32 was): 2 years ($8) younger than 17 years and 11 months, held as under 18 (a reading: whole ages don't hold the eleven months); 8 years ($32) from 18 to 72; then 7, 6, 5, 4 and 3 years ($28, $24, $20, $16, $12) at 73, 74, 75, 76 and 77; and 2 years ($8) from 78. The page marks the 73-to-77 terms as varying with the issue date and ending no later than the 80th birthday, which isn't held. Until then the file held the 8-year licence only. Later on 2026-10-30 each term was rewritten to hold the fee page's rate, $4 for each year of its term ('Operator - Class C $4/year'), charged for each of its years, in place of the products worked out here ($8 to $32), which the file held until then.
